(中南大学湘雅二医院临床药学研究室, 长沙 410011)SHEN Yuan, LI Huan - de(Clinical Pharmacy Research Institute, The Xiangya Second Hospital, Centra South University, Changsha 410011, China)Abstract: P - glycoprotein (P - gp) which belongs the ATP binding cassette transporter superfamily is one of the major transporters investigated. It is widespread on humans' lumina epithelial cells of intestines, lungs, kidneys and brain capillaries endothelium cells. As a great many drugs are substrates or modulators of P - gp, drug - drug interactions might be involved in clinical therapy. The review addressed P - gp and blood brain barrier; the research progress concerning role of P - gp played on central nervous system drugs; P - gp mediated drug - drug interaction and therapeutic effect or side effect on central nervous system.药物相互作用是指某种药物或化学物质引起另一种药物药代力学动或药效学水平上的干扰而发生疗效改变或产生不良反应 $^{[1]}$ 。药物相互作用除了可用药物代谢酶活性的调节来解释外，各种跨膜转运蛋白的功能和数量的改变也是一个重要原因。P-糖蛋白(P-glycoprotein, P-gp)是目前研究得较为清楚的转运体之一，它可阻止化疗药物进入肿瘤细胞导致交叉耐药反应 $^{[2]}$ 。由P-gp介导的药物相互作用得到越来越多的关注和重视 $^{[3-7]}$ 。本文重点介绍P-gp与血脑屏障、中枢神经系统(CNS)药物及P-gp介导的CNS药物相互作用及产生的疗效和副作用。
